bites.title: Fences and stretching
bites.body: Selections are fences: paint only lands inside them. Transform stretches, rotates and warps whatever's selected. Together they fix proportions without redrawing.

bites.title: Rectangle select
bites.body: Press {key:KisToolSelectRectangular|Ctrl+R} and drag a box over half the apple.

bites.title: Lasso
bites.body: Find the Freehand Selection tool in the toolbox (the lasso). Draw a loop around the apple.

bites.title: Invert
bites.body: Press {key:invert_selection|Ctrl+Shift+I}: now everything BUT the apple is selected.

bites.title: Transform
bites.body: Deselect, select the Apple layer, and press {key:KisToolTransform|Ctrl+T}. Drag a corner to squash it, outside a corner to rotate. Press Enter to apply.

bites.title: Warp, liquify, perspective
bites.body: In Tool Options the Transform tool has modes: Perspective, Warp, Cage, Liquify, Mesh. Liquify is a digital nudge-the-clay tool. Perfect for fixing a jaw or an eye that wandered.

bites.title: 15 cleared
bites.body: Rectangle, lasso, deselect, invert, transform, and the warp family.
